shadows.name: card
shadows.purpose: Resting elevation for every in-flow card/widget — replaces the earlier flat-at-rest rule.

shadows.name: card-hover
shadows.purpose: Hover state for genuinely clickable cards only (asset cards, provider cards).

shadows.name: sm
shadows.purpose: Small floating chips — the mobile menu button.

shadows.name: md
shadows.purpose: Mid-elevation floating panels — dropdowns, popovers, the account menu.

shadows.name: login-card
shadows.purpose: The login card only — same Y/blur as lg but a lighter 0.4 alpha to match that screen's lighter glass effect.

shadows.name: toast
shadows.purpose: Toast notifications — between sm and md, doesn't map onto either without changing its appearance.

shadows.name: chart-tooltip
shadows.purpose: Chart hover tooltips — a smaller, tighter shadow than the standard tooltip.

motion.name: reduced-motion-fallback
motion.purpose: Both of the above drop to an opacity-only fade when prefers-reduced-motion is set, via Framer Motion's useReducedMotion().

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Main call-to-action — flat solid magenta fill (no gradient), white text, fully rounded pill shape.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; font-family: "GT Eesti Pro Display", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; padding: 12px 20px; border-radius: 999px; border: none; background: #cf00a3; color: #fff; cursor: pointer; transition: filter 0.15s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.1); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #cf00a3; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: inherit; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Transparent, bordered, fully rounded pill — the default non-primary action.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; font-family: "GT Eesti Pro Text", system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; padding: 11px 18px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1px solid rgba(4, 17, 29, 0.14); background: transparent; color: #04111d; cursor: pointer; transition: background 0.15s, border-color 0.15s; } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: rgba(4, 17, 29, 0.05); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #cf00a3; outline-offset: 2px; border-radius: inherit; }

components.name: Status Pill (Overdue)
components.description: Solid-fill, fully-rounded status pill — the pattern every status/category badge follows: opaque background, white text, never a translucent wash. Background is OpenSea's own referenced red, darkened for a 5.5:1+ contrast margin.
components.css: .ds-pill-overdue { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 3px 9px; border-radius: 999px; background: #dc2626; border-color: transparent; color: #fff; font-size: 11px; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Category Badge
components.description: User-colored category chip, fully rounded — background is the user's own chosen color; text is white when that clears 4.5:1, otherwise a darkened shade of the same color (computed in lib/contrastText.js).
components.css: .ds-badge-category { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 600; white-space: nowrap; }

components.name: Card
components.description: The base in-flow surface — real soft-shadow elevation at rest (not flat), translucent ink-tinted background over the white page, generous 20px radius, neutral (not accent-tinted) border.
components.css: .ds-card { border-radius: 20px; padding: 18px; background: rgba(4, 17, 29, 0.04); border: 1px solid rgba(4, 17, 29, 0.08); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.04), 0 6px 16px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06); }

components.name: Input
components.description: Text input — faint ink-tinted fill at rest, 14px radius, magenta border + soft ring on focus.
components.css: .ds-input { width: 100%; padding: 10px 12px; border-radius: 14px; border: 1px solid rgba(4, 17, 29, 0.14); background: rgba(4, 17, 29, 0.03); color: #04111d; font-size: 14px; transition: border-color 0.15s, background 0.15s, box-shadow 0.15s; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: #cf00a3; background: #ffffff; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(207, 0, 163, 0.14); } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #656b71; }

narrative.northStar: The Operator's Ledger, Ported from OpenSea
narrative.overview: SERVIX is a single-operator cockpit, not a team product — one person tracking their own servers, domains, certificates, and a VPN-reselling business's real subscriber economics (MRR, churn, subscriber lifetime) in one place, self-hosted, with nothing routed through a third-party SaaS. The ledger identity (quiet neutrals, one magenta accent reserved for actionable elements) stays; the rest of the palette — neutrals, text hierarchy, semantic status colors, shape and elevation — is a direct, explicit port from OpenSea, requested twice: first as a shape/elevation reference, then as a full color-level port of its actual near-black/gray text hierarchy and semantic hues. The magenta accent was the one color pinned out of scope across both passes.
keyCharacteristics: Restrained color strategy: OpenSea's own near-achromatic white/gray neutrals and dark-navy text hierarchy + one magenta accent — not a tinted neutral scale (an earlier pass tried one; explicitly superseded).
A real, independent secondary/muted text hierarchy — distinct solid grays, not one ink color at varying opacity.
Pill-first shape language: buttons, badges, pills, search fields, and avatars are fully rounded; cards/modals use large but finite radii (20-24px).
Real resting elevation on cards/widgets — a deliberate reversal of an earlier flat-by-default rule.
Semantic status colors are OpenSea's own referenced hues, darkened only as far as needed for a genuine 5.5:1+ margin.
Every text/status color verified against every background it actually renders on, not just the lightest one.
Every Radix overlay/menu primitive is already in use; no hand-rolled dropdown, dialog, or toast remains.

rules.name: The Solid-Gray-Not-Alpha-Black Rule
rules.body: Text Secondary and Text Muted are independent solid colors, not --text at reduced opacity — an alpha-blended gray renders differently depending on what's behind it.

rules.name: The Solid Status Rule
rules.body: Status badges use a solid, opaque background with darkened semantic color and white (or contrast-computed) text — never a translucent wash with colored text on top.

rules.name: The Flat-Button Rule
rules.body: Primary/CTA buttons are a single flat fill, never a gradient — a direct OpenSea reference.

rules.name: The Check-Every-Background Rule
rules.body: A text/status color is verified against every background it actually renders on, not just the palest one — a muted gray that passed against the white page failed against the slightly darker sidebar until checked explicitly.

rules.name: The No-Offset Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is 0 <Y> <blur> rgba(0,0,0,<alpha>) — no x-offset, no spread, ever.

dos: Do use the pill radius for any new button, badge, pill, search input, or avatar.
Do give any new in-flow card/widget the card shadow at rest (and card-hover only if genuinely clickable).
Do use the darkened semantic tokens for anything that renders as text.
Do check a new text/status color against every background it will actually render on, not just the lightest.
Do reach for a Radix primitive first for anything overlay/menu/dialog-shaped.
donts: Don't reintroduce a gradient on the primary button.
Don't outline a card/panel in the magenta accent — the border is neutral now.
Don't derive secondary/muted text as an alpha of --text — use the named solid grays.
Don't use a translucent color wash as a badge/pill/status background with colored text on top.
Don't introduce a shadow with an x-offset or spread.
Don't hand-roll a dropdown, dialog, tooltip, or toast.
